bio.text: Peter Oberacker is a Republican state senator who was first elected to New York's 51st Senate District in 2020.
He won the Republican primary for New York's 19th Congressional District on June 23, 2026, and will face Democratic Rep. Josh Riley in November, Spectrum News reported.
Before the Legislature he operated Spicey Pete's Meats with his father and worked as a research chef and food scientist, and he served as a town supervisor in Maryland, N.Y.
WNYT reported that he served as a volunteer firefighter.
